fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Online Form 2026 – Start - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Forensic Science Laboratory on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 208 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 has started from 27 July 2026, and candidates can apply until 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
